start: Menu, 'Help and feedback'

steps.action: Type a question in 'Your message' and tap 'Send'
user_sees: 'Sending…' on the button
An answer with 'Answer written by AI from our help pages.' and 'Did this solve it?' Yes / No; or 'Thanks! We read every message.'
must_not: The typed text lost when the send fails

steps.action: Tap 'Yes' or 'No'
user_sees: 'Great! Glad it helped.' or 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.'
must_not: The question missing from 'Your questions'

start: Help and feedback, card 'MettleUp access' (owner of an online gym)

steps.action: Read the card
user_sees: Every time MettleUp support opened the gym's records, or 'MettleUp has never opened your records.'
must_not: An opening by HQ that is not listed

steps.action: Tap 'Let MettleUp support look (1 hour)'
user_sees: Sheet 'Let MettleUp support look?' saying support can read members, plans, receipts, check-ins, shop orders and the staff list for the next hour and cannot change anything; button 'Yes, for 1 hour'
must_not: Access that stays open after an hour, or opens without the owner's yes

start: Any place that shows the support line

steps.action: Tap the address after 'Need help? Email MettleUp at'
user_sees: The device's mail app opens with MettleUp's address filled in
must_not: An email sent by itself, or gym data put into the mail

start: Help and feedback

steps.action: Leave the box empty
user_sees: 'Send' is disabled
must_not: An empty message sent

steps.action: Send with no internet
user_sees: 'Couldn't send. Check your internet and try again. Your message is still here.'
must_not: The message cleared, or 'Thanks!' shown

steps.action: Send when the gym has no AI credit left
user_sees: An answer from the help pages; the owner also gets 'Open AI Assistant', staff do not
must_not: A credit taken for an answer the AI did not write

start: Help and feedback, 'Your questions'

steps.action: Come back later
user_sees: Each question with its day, then a waiting line, the AI answer, or the team's reply with a new badge
A rated answer shows what was chosen
must_not: A reply marked new for ever, or a question shown twice

start: Help and feedback, 'MettleUp access'

user_sees: 'MettleUp sees only your gym's totals (how many members, check-ins and money in all), never a member's name or number. MettleUp support can look at your records only when you let them, for one hour at most...'
must_not: Support reading a member's name outside a window the owner opened
